name: Master Weaver Ottilie
title: Master of the Artisans' Hall
examine: Thread-ends pinned to her sleeve in an order that is absolutely a filing system. The Hold's banners were born on her looms.
lines: Mind the loom tension. It's set finer than you'd believe.
I wove every banner in the High Hall. The Warden asked for 'something dignified'. She received it. Mostly.
Lowland cotton, mountain wool, deep gloomsilk. It all comes to my loom eventually.
